name: PAY_AMER_INTERFACE_PARAMETERS
description: This table contains the file version and parameter details of various North America processes.

columns.name: INTERFACE_PARAM_ID
columns.description: Unique Key to identify a record

columns.name: CONTENT_PROVIDER
columns.description: Data Source Provider

columns.name: VERSION_LOADED
columns.description: Version of file last loaded by the process

columns.name: CONTENT_FILE_LOCATION
columns.description: Location of file last used by the process

columns.name: CONTENT_FILE_NAME
columns.description: Name of the file last used by the process

columns.name: UPLOADED_OLDER_VERSION
columns.description: Flag to indicate if the process uploaded previous or older version of file

columns.name: PROCESS_NAME
columns.description: Unique Name to identify the process

columns.name: COUNTRY_CODE
columns.description: Country Code

columns.name: PROCESS_UPDATE_DATE

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.
